description: Dept. of Trade & Investment Policy -  Special Commodity Levy on B'onions with effect from 03.03.2019
reasoning: This gazette content involves the imposition of a Special Commodity Levy under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007. It constitutes a regulatory order that creates a new financial obligation (a levy) on a specific commodity (onions). This falls under the category of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) as it represents subsidiary legislation/regulatory action taken under an existing Act of Parliament, establishing compliance requirements and modifying the legal framework for commodity taxation.
